rulingTitle: When acquisition resolves before an overdue deadline timer runs, acquire() awaits release() after expiry, delaying rejection arbitrarily; a probe with a 20 ms budget, 45 ms event-loop stall and 200 ms release rejected at 254 ms.

action.reason: The post-acquisition expiry path awaits release(), so slow cleanup can delay timeout rejection without bound. This violates US-004’s single acquisition deadline and is not safe to waive.

rationale: Confirmed in acquire(): an overdue acquisition awaits release before throwing, unlike the timer-expiry path. Cleanup rejection can also replace the intended timeout error. Before readiness, initiate release with rejection handling without awaiting it, then throw the timeout immediately. Add a regression covering acquisition resolution before an overdue timer with slow cleanup; verify prompt timeout, no modify callback, and eventual lock release. Existing acceptance expectations need not change.
